verdict.rationale: Steel's Agent Traces turn a run into a timeline of agent activity so you can see what happened without scrubbing the recording [steel-docs-6]. Runs export as markdown, JSON, or a ZIP with screenshots [steel-docs-7], backed by dedicated timeline/exports and traces API docs [steel-docs-28][steel-docs-29], and Steel advertises session replays and agent observability [steel-docs-11]. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of video replay playback (only referenced as 'recording' and 'session replays'), and independent or hands-on corroboration of debugging failed runs.
